sloka: ततः सा नवमे मासि इला सोमसुतात्सुतम् ।जनयामास सुश्रोणी पुरूरवसमूर्जितम् ।। ७.८९.२३ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ sā navame māsi ilā somasutātsutam ।janayāmāsa suśroṇī purūravasamūrjitam ।। 7.89.23 ॥

translations.english: Then, in the ninth month, Ila, who had beautiful hips, gave birth to a mighty son named Pururavas from Budha, the son of Soma.
